summary: Solaris Energy Infrastructure, Inc. via its subsidiary issued $1.3B of 6.375% Senior Notes due 2031 in a private placement under Rule 144A/Reg S. Proceeds (~$1.276B net) used to repay outstanding borrowings and for general corporate/growth capex. Notes are senior unsecured, guaranteed by parent and subsidiary guarantors, and rank above existing convertible notes. Optional redemption up to 40% with equity offering proceeds at 106.375% before May 2028. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or activist event; this is a routine debt refinancing/capital markets transaction. Filing is an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement for a straight debt issuance, not a special situation.
